title: Timber monitoring: moist-air relations, response model and humidity-led conservation heating for historic timber
description: Code, data and method from the environmental monitoring of the Rotunda, Woolwich (John Nash, 1814; Grade II*). Magnus-Sonntag psychrometrics, condensation margin and surface humidity, a first-order response model fitted on the trailing week, and a humidity-led conservation heating and ventilation strategy. Code MIT; text, figures and data CC BY 4.0. Rotunda Trust Limited, company 17115816, registered charity 1220458.
